correctness.rationale: The idempotent RB condition is exactly complementary subalgebra closure. Every proper subalgebra containing a unit contains 1; the radical multiplication is the alternating determinant times z, whence the only radical planes closed under product contain z. Dimension analysis exhausts all complement configurations; automorphism parameters prove one orbit per incidence family; counting lines outside each of q+1 planes gives q²(q+1). Exhaustive finite subspace enumeration and direct 16-pair identity checks were run for prime fields q=2,3,5; no finite test is claimed as the general proof.

value.rationale: The full automorphism-orbit classification for a canonical splitting-operator locus on the smallest noncommutative exterior algebra is a natural invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Its incidence-bundle geometry produces rank-stratified exact counts for every finite field including characteristic two and supplies benchmarks for operator classification beyond real and characteristic-zero methods. The known general splitting theorem does not answer these orbit/enumeration questions.
